ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Left: explicit-Euler SIR trajectory at step 0.1 day with N = 1000, initial S = 990, I = 10, R = 0, beta = 0.3 per day and gamma = 0.1 per day. Total population is conserved while group sizes change. Right: infectious counts for beta = 0.3 versus 0.08 with the same other inputs. These are synthetic scenarios, not fitted forecasts or intervention estimates.
ns0:svg.ns0:title: Closed-population trajectories and two contact-rate scenarios
